newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech ruling coalition wins 52 of 81 Senate seats.
newsitem.headline: Czech ruling coalition wins 52 of 81 Senate seats.

text.p: The ruling coalition of Czech Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus, according to preliminary results, won 52 of the 81 seats in the newly-created upper house of parliament, the Senate, after second round runoff elections ended on Saturday.
Klaus's Civic Democratic Party (ODS) took 32 seats in the Senate, while coalition partners the Christian Democrats (KDU-CSL) won 13 seats and the Civic Democratic Alliance (ODA) gained seven seats.
